total.description: Exact decimal sales total in provider accounting units.

soldAt.description: Verified sale instant in UTC Z, only for rows that actually represent a sale instant.

currency.description: Explicit provider currency code, if supplied.

quantity.description: Exact decimal quantity in provider units; no inferred unit count.

functions.name: list-staff

limit.description: Staff records per page, default and conservative maximum 100.

functions.name: list-widget-events
functions.description: List the events exposed by an event widget, optionally within a specified facility and date-time range. Facility-scoped requests require both date-time bounds.

endAt.description: Optional end boundary as an RFC 3339 instant with an explicit offset. Must be later than startAt when both are supplied. Required with facilityCode; endpoint inclusivity is provider-defined and provisional.

startAt.description: Optional start boundary as an RFC 3339 instant with an explicit offset. Required with facilityCode. Endpoint inclusivity is provider-defined and provisional.

facilityCode.description: Optional opaque facility code selecting the facility-scoped event view. Both date-time bounds are required when provided.

eventWidgetId.description: Opaque event widget GUID, obtained from list-event-widgets or existing widget configuration.

FunctionInput_rock_gym_pro_listwidgeteve.description: Widget identifier and optional facility and instant boundaries for one event selection.

id.description: Opaque identifier for this event occurrence within the widget; exact provider source is provisional.

title.description: Event title in ordinary text, preserving Unicode and an explicitly empty title; omitted when unavailable.

endsAt.description: Event end instant normalized to UTC with Z without losing available fractional precision; omitted if no unambiguous end instant is supplied.

startsAt.description: Event start instant normalized to UTC with Z without losing available fractional precision; omitted if the provider does not supply an unambiguous instant.

bookingUrl.description: Provider-supplied URL for viewing or booking this event; omitted when unavailable. Returning it does not create a booking.

description.description: Event description exactly as returned after transport decoding, including any provider markup; omitted when unavailable.

facilityCode.description: Facility code for the requested scoped view or an explicit facility reference on the event; omitted when unknown.

eventWidgetId.description: Opaque identifier of the widget from which this event was read.

items.description: One widget event occurrence with available provider content and unambiguous instants.
Events in the widget's returned selection; empty when no events match. This is one provider response, not a promise of historical completeness.

FunctionOutput_rock_gym_pro_listwidgetev.description: One provider-selected collection of widget event occurrences.

tags.instructions: Use this to read the event collection for a known widget, not to retrieve widget settings or make a booking. Discover widget IDs with `list-event-widgets`. Supply facilityCode to use the facility-scoped view; that view requires both date-time bounds. Without a facility, either bound may be omitted to retain the provider's default selection. This returns one provider response, with no documented paging controls; use a focused date range for large calendars.
